// forge_core::provider::Factory (exact):
//   pub trait Factory<T> { type Error; fn create(&self) -> Result<T, Self::Error>; }
invariants: The factory never connects at construction or staging time - only create() connects.
responsibilities: Hold one PgConfig (cloned per create, so one factory can create many sessions).
create() is exactly PgSession::connect with the staged config.
config() exposes the staged configuration for diagnostics.
summary: The forge-core Factory for adapter sessions: stages one PgConfig, connects on create(). Registration validates, create() effects.
